title.narrative: Promoting the Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Supply Chains in Türkiye’s Earthquake Recovery

description.narrative: Following the 2023 earthquakes in Türkiye impacting 11 provinces that cover a vast area in southern and southeast Türkiye with a total population of 15.6 million, the aims to promote responsible business practice in Turkiye’s earthquake recovery and, in particular, promoting the rights of people with disabilities . To this end, the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs) offer a helpful framework for the engagement of private business in an inclusive recovery. The project envisages sectoral assessment to generate actionable recommendations for businesses to improve human rights practices and the support to the Interagency Working Group on BHR in its effort to create policy environment, initially focusing on disability and business, with methodologies scalable to other issues like women’s rights and digitalization.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
